name: Connecting
when: Signing in to a data source or service

variants.name: Plug
variants.desc: Pushes a plug into a socket and hops at the zap.

variants.name: Signal
variants.desc: Tilts to find a signal as the wifi bars light up.

variants.name: Link
variants.desc: Two chain links click together and a tick appears.

variants.name: Ping
variants.desc: Pings a server; the lights blink back and it turns green.

variants.name: Antenna
variants.desc: Pops up an antenna that wobbles and sends out waves.

parts.t: <g class="att att-ant" transform="translate(50 {{a.top}})"><g class="a ant"><path class="lnk" d="M0 1Q-3 -8 3 -15"></path><circle class="coral" cx="3" cy="-16" r="3.6"></circle></g></g>

<g class="fx-plug" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><rect class="pw" x="90" y="51" width="8" height="18" rx="2"></rect><path class="lnk2" d="M90 57.5H92M90 62.5H92"></path><g class="a plg"><path class="wire" d="M82 60Q77 60 77 67T73 80"></path><rect class="dk" x="81" y="55.5" width="6" height="9" rx="1.5"></rect><path class="lnk2" d="M87 57.5H90.5M87 62.5H90.5"></path></g><g class="a zap"><path d="M93 38L89 45H92.5L90.5 50L96.5 42.5H93L95 38Z" fill="#F2B33D" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round" style="stroke: var(--aa-ink, #3A3833)"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-wifi" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 9)"><circle class="dk wf0" cx="0" cy="0" r="2.2"></circle><path class="wifi wf1" d="M-3.9 -3.9A5.5 5.5 0 0 1 3.9 -3.9"></path><path class="wifi wf2" d="M-7 -7A9.9 9.9 0 0 1 7 -7"></path><path class="wifi wf3" d="M-10.1 -10.1A14.3 14.3 0 0 1 10.1 -10.1"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-chain" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 5)"><rect class="a lk1 chain" x="-11" y="-4" width="12" height="8" rx="4"></rect><rect class="a lk2 chain" x="-1" y="-4" width="12" height="8" rx="4"></rect><g transform="translate(10 -7)"><g class="a lkok"><circle class="okf" cx="0" cy="0" r="4"></circle><path class="wck" d="M-2 0L-0.5 1.5L2 -1.5"></path></g></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-server" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.dn}})"><rect class="pw" x="87" y="60" width="13" height="10" rx="1.5"></rect><rect class="pw" x="87" y="71" width="13" height="10" rx="1.5"></rect><path class="line2" d="M90 65H93M90 76H93"></path><circle class="led" cx="96" cy="65" r="1.4"></circle><circle class="led" cx="96" cy="76" r="1.4"></circle><g><circle class="pd dk" cx="78.5" cy="68" r="1.2"></circle><circle class="pd dk" cx="81.5" cy="68" r="1.2"></circle><circle class="pd dk" cx="84.5" cy="68" r="1.2"></circle></g><g transform="translate(99 58)"><g class="a srvok"><circle class="okf" cx="0" cy="0" r="3.6"></circle><path class="wck" d="M-1.8 0L-0.4 1.4L1.8 -1.4"></path></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-waves" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(53 1)"><path class="a wv thin" d="M-5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 0 -5 4M5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 1 5 4"></path><path class="a wv thin" d="M-5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 0 -5 4M5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 1 5 4"></path><path class="a wv thin" d="M-5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 0 -5 4M5 -4A6.4 6.4 0 0 1 5 4"></path></g></g>
